summary: Roche-reported lidERA results support adjuvant efficacy through improved invasive disease-free survival. Overall survival remains immature; safety and manufacturing cannot be assessed from the supplied packet.
pivotalQuestion: Does lidERA’s invasive disease-free-survival benefit establish a favorable adjuvant benefit–risk balance while overall survival remains immature?

factors.rationale: Roche reports improved invasive disease-free survival in lidERA: HR 0.70 (95% CI 0.57–0.87); three-year estimates 92.4% versus 89.6%. Overall survival remains immature, without established benefit.
The supplied packet provides no interpretable safety results for this adjuvant application.
No product-linked manufacturing, facility compliance, or CMC assessment is supplied.
Roche reported priority-review acceptance for the adjuvant NDA; its July update continued to list the filing. These are process milestones, not evidence of approval.
